description.content: First-party REST API (WordPress REST namespace members/v1) powering the Next Big Idea Club subscription, membership, library and course experience across web and the iOS/Android apps. Paths and HTTP methods derived verbatim from the provider-published /wp-json/ route discovery document; request/response schemas are not published by the provider.
